title: Candy
author: Terry Southern, Mason Hoffenberg
current_text: Candy by Terry Southern and Mason Hoffenberg was banned by the Paris vice squad after Olympia published it in October 1958. The Indecent Publications Tribunal banned Candy in New Zealand in 1969 after ruling it indecent.

sources.quote: published in UK Harper's Bazaar in August 1958. In October, Olympia published Candy under the pseudonym Maxwell Kenton, and it immediately was banned by the Paris vice squad.
sources.title: Terry Southern (Wikipedia)

ban_rows.note: The NZ Indecent Publications Tribunal ruled Candy indecent on 30 January 1969.
